hypotheses.D0_path_recomposition_survives_controls: Every cell recomposes operator and logit JVPs to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.D1_injection_dominance_survives_controls: Repeated injections receive at least 0.75 operator and Fisher projection share in every corpus-position-donor cell.
hypotheses.D2_final_group_remains_minor: The Layer-15-17 injection group has absolute operator and Fisher share at most 0.15 in every cell.
hypotheses.D3_middle_groups_are_jointly_material: Layers 6-11 jointly receive at least 0.30 operator and Fisher projection share in every cell.
hypotheses.D4_layer6_8_is_usually_largest_operator_: Layers 6-8 are the largest injection group by operator share in at least 80% of cells.
hypotheses.D5_donor_pairing_does_not_control_inject: Within each corpus and position group, injection-all share ranges by at most 0.15 across donor shifts in both metrics.
hypotheses.D6_position_choice_does_not_control_inje: Within each corpus and donor shift, injection-all share differs by at most 0.15 between original and unseen positions in both metrics.
hypotheses.D7_small_edit_linearity_survives_control: The 0.01x JVP reaches at least 0.99 operator and Fisher fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.D8_full_edit_nonlinearity_survives_contr: The 1.0x JVP is at least 0.10 worse than the 0.01x JVP in operator or Fisher fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.D9_operator_and_fisher_agree_on_injectio: Injection-all projection share differs by at most 0.15 between operator and Fisher metrics in every cell.
hypotheses.D10_initial_plus_bus_remains_minor: Initial plus bus projection share is at most 0.25 in operator and Fisher geometry in every cell.
